text_en: Listen to me, O coastlands, pay attention, you peoples from far away! The Lord called me before I was born, while I was in my mother’s womb he named me.
text_cn: 诸岛屿，请听我！远方的人民，请静听！上主由母腹中就召叫了我，自母胎中就给我起了名字。

text_en: He made my mouth like a sharp sword, in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me a polished arrow, in his quiver he hid me away.
text_cn: 他使我的口好似利剑，将我掩护在他的手荫下，使我像一支磨光的箭，将我隐藏在他的箭囊中。

text_en: And he said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified. ”
text_cn: 他对我说：“你是我的仆人，是我骄矜的‘以色列’。”

text_en: But I said, “I have labored in vain, I have spent my strength for nothing and vanity; yet surely my cause is with the Lord , and my reward with my God. ”
text_cn: 但是我说：“我白白勤劳了，我枉费了气力而毫无益处；但是我的权利是在上主那里，我的报酬在我的天主面前。”

text_en: And now the Lord says, who formed me in the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob back to him, and that Israel might be gathered to him, for I am honored in the sight of the Lord , and my God has become my strength—
text_cn: 我在上主眼中是光荣的，天主是我的力量。那由母胎形成我作他的仆人，将雅各伯领回到他前，并把以色列聚在他前的上主，如今说：

text_en: he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to restore the survivors of Israel; I will give you as a light to the nations, that my salvation may reach to the end of the earth. ”
text_cn: “你作我的仆人，复兴雅各伯支派，领回以色列遗留下的人，还是小事，我更要使你作万民的光明，使我的救恩达于地极。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord , the Redeemer of Israel and his Holy One, to one deeply despised, abhorred by the nations, the slave of rulers, “Kings shall see and stand up, princes, and they shall prostrate themselves, because of the Lord , who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you. ”
text_cn: 上主，以色列的救主和圣者，向那极受轻慢，为列国所憎恶，且作统治者奴役的人这样说：“列王必要见而起立，诸侯必要见而下拜：这是因为上主忠实可靠，以色列的圣者拣选了你的缘故。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord : In a time of favor I have answered you, on a day of salvation I have helped you; I have kept you and given you as a covenant to the people, to establish the land, to apportion the desolate heritages;
text_cn: 上主这样说：在悦纳的时候，我俯允了你；在救恩的日期，我帮助了你；我必保护你，使你作为人民的盟约，复兴国家，分得荒芜的产业，

text_en: saying to the prisoners, “Come out, ” to those who are in darkness, “Show yourselves. ” They shall feed along the ways, on all the bare heights shall be their pasture;
text_cn: 好向俘虏说：“你们出来吧！”向在黑暗中的人说：“你们出现吧！”他们将在各路上被牧放，他们的牧场是在一切荒岭上。

text_en: they shall not hunger or thirst, neither scorching wind nor sun shall strike them down, for he who has pity on them will lead them, and by springs of water will guide them.
text_cn: 他们不饿也不渴，热风和烈日也不损伤他们，因为那怜悯他们的率领着他们，引领他们到水泉旁。

text_en: And I will turn all my mountains into a road, and my highways shall be raised up.
text_cn: 我要使我的一切山岭变为大路，并把我的街道修高。

text_en: Lo, these shall come from far away, and lo, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Syene.
text_cn: 看啊！有的由远方而来，有的由北方和西方而来，还有些由息宁而来。

text_en: Sing for joy, O heavens, and exult, O earth; break forth, O mountains, into singing! For the Lord has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his suffering ones.
text_cn: 诸天要欢乐，大地要踊跃，山岭要欢呼高唱，因为上主安慰了他的百姓，怜恤了他受苦的人们。

text_en: But Zion said, “The Lord has forsaken me, my Lord has forgotten me. ”
text_cn: 熙雍曾说过：“上主离弃了我，吾主忘掉了我。”

text_en: Can a woman forget her nursing child, or show no compassion for the child of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you.
text_cn: 妇女岂能忘掉自己的乳婴？初为人母的，岂能忘掉亲生的儿子？纵然她们能忘掉，我也不能忘掉你啊？

text_en: See, I have inscribed you on the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.
text_cn: 看啊！我已把你刻在我的手掌上，你的城墙时常在我的眼前。

text_en: Your builders outdo your destroyers, and those who laid you waste go away from you.
text_cn: 建筑你的工人急速动工，那毁灭你和破坏你的，要离你远去。

text_en: Lift up your eyes all around and see; they all gather, they come to you. As I live, says the Lord , you shall put all of them on like an ornament, and like a bride you shall bind them on.
text_cn: 你举目四望吧！他们都已集合到你这里来；我永远生活──上主的断语──他们必如装饰品穿戴在你身上，把你装扮得有如新娘。

text_en: Surely your waste and your desolate places and your devastated land— surely now you will be too crowded for your inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.
text_cn: 至于你的废址，你那荒芜和遭蹂躏之地，如今为你的居民太狭小了，因为吞噬你的人已远离他去。

text_en: The children born in the time of your bereavement will yet say in your hearing: “The place is too crowded for me; make room for me to settle. ”
text_cn: 连你在不孕期中所生的子女也要说给你听：“这地方为我太狭小了，请给我一个住处吧！”

text_en: Then you will say in your heart, “Who has borne me these? I was bereaved and barren, exiled and put away— so who has reared these? I was left all alone— where then have these come from? ”
text_cn: 那时你心里会问：“谁给我生育了这些人呢？我原是不妊不孕的，【且是流放被逐的，】这些人是谁给我养大的？看！我本是孤苦零丁的，他们却是从哪里来的？”

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : I will soon lift up my hand to the nations, and raise my signal to the peoples; and they shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“看！我要向列邦高举我的手，向万民树起我的旗帜；他们必要把你的儿子抱在怀中带来，把你的女儿放在肩上背来。

text_en: Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. With their faces to the ground they shall bow down to you, and lick the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am the Lord ; those who wait for me shall not be put to shame.
text_cn: 列王要作你的养父，皇后要当你的保姆。他们要在你面前俯伏在地，并要舐（shì）去你脚上的尘土；那时你将知道：我是上主；凡仰赖我的，决不会蒙羞。”

text_en: Can the prey be taken from the mighty, or the captives of a tyrant be rescued?
text_cn: 猎物岂能由勇士手中夺回？俘虏岂能由强者手中救出？

text_en: But thus says the Lord : Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken, and the prey of the tyrant be rescued; for I will contend with those who contend with you, and I will save your children.
text_cn: 但是，上主这样说：“俘虏必要由勇士手中夺回，猎物必要由强者手中救出。我必与同你争夺的人争夺，我必拯救你的子孙。

text_en: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh, and they shall be drunk with their own blood as with wine. Then all flesh shall know that I am the Lord your Savior, and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
text_cn: 我要使压迫你的人吃自己的肉，喝自己的血如喝新酒。如此，凡有血肉的人都知道我是上主，是你的拯救者，是你的救主，是雅各伯的大能者。”
